title: Story premise ENT073: The Line Across Two Windows
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (silent emotional stories). Hook: One line reaches the next window. Takeaway/theme: Connection can be gentle and leave room for quiet.
description: Two neighbors want company without interrupting each other’s quiet evenings. One draws a small hill on a window, the other continues the line on theirs, and over several nights the separate drawings become one landscape that both sit beside with their lights on.
